description: Confluence root: the Data Center server (https://confluence.imagile.dev), or the Cloud site without /wiki (https://<your-site>.atlassian.net)
Data Center: a personal access token. Cloud: an Atlassian account API token
Which Confluence this is: "server" for Data Center (the default), or "cloud" for Confluence Cloud
Confluence Cloud only: the email address of the Atlassian account the API token belongs to
The jira connection to take apiToken from when this connection has none
